def settings(keys: list[str], values: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    """Overlay keys[i]=values[i] on the defaults mode=fast and level=3.
    Returns mode, level, then the other keys in first-seen order."""
    pre keys.len() == values.len()
    post out.len() >= 2
    ex settings(keys=[], values=[]) == ["fast", "3"]
    ex settings(keys=["mode"], values=["slow"]) == ["slow", "3"]
    ex settings(keys=["x", "mode"], values=["1", "slow"]) == ["slow", "3", "1"]
    ex settings(keys=["x", "x"], values=["1", "2"]) == ["fast", "3", "2"]
    overrides: dict[str, str] = {}
    for i in range(keys.len()):
        overrides[keys[i].copy()] = values[i].copy()
    mode = overrides.get("mode") else "fast"
    level = overrides.get("level") else "3"
    out: list[str] = [mode, level]
    for k, v in overrides.items():
        if k == "mode" or k == "level":
            continue
        out.append(v.copy())
    return out
